targetAudience: Creators, filmmakers, and engineers exploring code-driven cinema

emotionalArc.fromState: Intrigue — questioning why great film cuts feel invisible to the conscious mind
emotionalArc.tensionState: Sensory tension — feeling the visual chaos of broken eye-trace and competing brightness before order snaps in
emotionalArc.toState: Cinematic awe — visceral payoff as silence, warm gold color shift, and precision typography lock together
emotionalArc.coreThesis: Great editing is not timeline software; it is deterministic human perception, color hierarchy, and acoustic restraint.

kuleshovStrategy: Never show film-reel or scissors clipart. Visualize the actual physics of perception: a 60ms foveal reticle jumping vs locking, 4 competing cards dimming into a 60-30-10 OKLCH prism, and a live acoustic waveform flatlining into dead silence right before the gold climax.
antiGoals: Zero fade-from-black on Frame 0 (start mid-slice at full contrast)
Zero literal video-editing icons (no clapperboards, film strips, or scissors)
Zero raw #FFFFFF highlights or uniform scene durations
Zero bottom subtitle collisions over multi-element visual diagrams
